title: Regret-Based Scenario-Tree Construction for Multistage Stochastic Programs with Deterministic Constraints
summary: Scenario trees are widely used to discretize multistage stochastic programs into forms that are tractable for numerical optimization. Yet, traditional scenario-tree construction methods are typically based on statistical similarity between the original uncertainty process and its discretization, and may fail to preserve the aspects of the uncertainty that matter most for decision-making.
